title: Tilting theory on continuous quivers (I) maximal rigid and tilting subcategories
summary: Let $\mathrm{rep}(\mathbb I)$ be the category of finitely generated persistence modules on the interval $\mathbb I\subseteq\mathbb R$. We study the maximal rigid subcategories of $\mathrm{rep}(\mathbb I)$. Maximal rigid interval consistent subcategories are classified via tilting modules over the corresponding discrete type $A$ quiver.
